Motherhood comes with a baby… but where is the MAP for the mother? ❤️

Pregnancy. Parenting. Relationships. Mom guilt. Identity. Mental health. The beautiful moments… and the messy ones too.

🎙️ Introducing MAPS – Motherhood & Parenting Support — a heartfelt podcast by Kanika Gowda & Pragati Goel, where we talk about the things parents often feel but don't always say out loud.

No perfect parenting.
No judgement.
Just honest conversations, real experiences & practical support. 🌿

Because when a mother feels supported, the whole family feels supported.

✨ Our MAPS journey begins soon. Watch out this space for our very first episode.

What happens when children get the freedom to create their own stories and confidently share them with others? 🌟

At ABC Learning, we believe public speaking isn't just about speaking in front of an audience. It's about helping children think creatively, express their ideas, build confidence and find their own voice. ❤️

In this fun and interactive session, children explored the world of story creation and public speaking through engaging activities and imagination.

✨ What the children explored:

🎤 Speaking confidently in front of others
📖 Creating their own stories
💡 Turning ideas and imagination into narratives
🗣️ Expressing thoughts clearly
🎭 Using voice, expressions and storytelling
🤝 Listening and learning from each other
🌱 Building confidence in a fun, supportive environment

The goal was not to create perfect speakers or perfect stories. It was to give every child a chance to speak, imagine, create and be heard.

Because sometimes, the little story a child creates today becomes the confidence they carry tomorrow. ✨

Listen. Imagine. Create. Speak. Grow. 🌱

There’s something incredibly heartwarming about seeing little champs enjoy a book written by me! ❤️📚

I absolutely love receiving these adorable feedbacks from my young readers and little story-listeners. Their innocent reactions and excitement make every word worth it! ✨

A big shout-out to all the parents who consciously take out time to read with their little ones. 👏❤️ In these fast-paced, screen-led times, there’s nothing quite like winding down the day with a cosy book in those little hands and a beautiful story before bedtime. 🌙📖

Because sometimes, the best bedtime routine is simply… a parent, a child & a good book. ❤️

Keep reading, keep imagining, keep storytelling! ✨
